test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence in the future tense.

options.text: I could be twenty five next Sunday.
I should be twenty five next Sunday.
I have been twenty five next Sunday.
I will be twenty five next Sunday.

solution:
The correct answer is ‘4’ i.e. I will be twenty five next Sunday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'I will be twenty five next Sunday' is in the future tense.
 
 
• The use of **'will be'** indicates an event that is certain to happen in the future.
 
 
 
• The other options are not in the future tense:
 
 
• **Option 1:** 'I could be twenty five next Sunday' uses 'could,' which indicates possibility but not a certain future event.
 
• **Option 2:** 'I should be twenty five next Sunday' uses 'should,' which indicates obligation or expectation, not a certain future event.
 
• **Option 3:** 'I have been twenty five next Sunday' is grammatically incorrect because it mixes present perfect tense with a future time reference.
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Future tense in English can be formed using 'will' followed by the base form of the verb.
 
 
• **Example:** *She will arrive tomorrow.*
